SELECT
            , BCC.CRDACCT_PRIOR_YR_BP
            , CRDACCT_CTD_BP_ADD
            , CRDACCT_CTD_BP_DED
            , CRDACCT_MTD_BP_ADD
            , CRDACCT_MTD_BP_DED
            , CRDACCT_MTD_BP_MDB
            , BCC.BNK_CODE
            , BCC.INSERT_DTTM
            , 1 AS Monthly_Daily
        FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC
        WHERE isLatest = 1
